title: Endometrial Injury for Assisted Reproduction
brief_summary: The objective of this study is to evaluate the effect of endometrial injury performed prior ovulation induction for assisted reproductive techniques main outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women who will start assisted reproductive techniques with planned fresh embryo transfer.
* Age between 18 and 38 years.
* Written informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
